title: sesamum integribracteatum subsp. ellipticum
intro: Sesamum integribracteatum subsp. ellipticum, commonly known as the wild sesame, is a plant species within the sesame family. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, skin infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sesamum integribracteatum subsp. ellipticum include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight free radicals, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
